items.title: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
items.content: The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.

items.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
items.content: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Ethereum devs won’t fork Glamsterdam on Hoodi until smart contract risks resolved
items.content: Ethereum developers are investigating concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants tied to Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038.

items.title: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
items.content: Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.

items.title: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates
items.content: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.

items.title: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
items.content: Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.

items.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
items.content: Greece has approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains starting in 2027, with an exemption for investors whose annual net gains do not exceed 500 euros.

items.title: GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
items.content: South Korea’s GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a hacking threat, with manual withdrawals available through support.

items.title: Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards
items.content: Experts say blockchain records show repeated wallet drains but cannot establish Binance’s internal signing controls or transaction limits.

items.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
items.content: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.

items.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
items.content: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
items.content: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.

items.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
items.content: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.

items.title: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
items.content: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.

items.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
items.content: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.

items.title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
items.content: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.

items.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
items.content: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

items.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
items.content: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.

items.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
items.content: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

items.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
items.content: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

items.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
items.content: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

items.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
items.content: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

items.title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
items.content: Bitcoin saw sudden downside at the Wall Street open as stocks witnessed a snap sell-off, reversing post-election gains.

items.title: Blockchain is ‘perfect solution’ for AI agent trust, VeChain CEO says
items.content: Sunny Lu said AI agents would need identity and reputation systems, making the case while promoting agent-building platform VeWorld.ai.

items.title: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?
items.content: Decentralized AI networks want to turn everyday phones into an alternative to centralized computing infrastructure  — but skeptics have their doubts.

items.title: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says
items.content: The SkyBridge founder said disputes over ethics restrictions also stalled negotiations, with both sides responsible for the setback.

items.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
items.content: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.

items.title: Bitcoin win rate vs. S&P 500 recovers as post-midterm history favors stocks
items.content: Bitcoin outperformed the S&P 500 in half of the past 90 US trading sessions, while historical midterm data highlights gains for stocks.

items.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
items.content: South Korea is seeking a fourth delay to its 22% crypto tax, months after reaffirming plans to begin taxing digital asset gains in January 2027.
